narration.say: How could machines learn as efficiently as humans and animals?
narration.show: “How could machines learn as efficiently as humans and animals?”

narration.say: How could machines learn to reason, and plan?
narration.show: “How could machines learn to reason and plan?”

narration.say: A baby learns how the world works, just by watching.
narration.show: A baby learns how the world works, just by *watching*.

narration.say: No labels. No teacher. Just the world, rolling on.
narration.show: No labels. No teacher. Just the world, rolling on.

narration.say: So we taught machines to guess what happens next,
narration.show: So we taught machines to guess what happens next,

narration.say: by painting every single pixel of the future.
narration.show: by painting *every single pixel* of the future.

narration.say: But the future is uncertain. Leaves flutter. Water ripples.
narration.show: But the future is *uncertain*. Leaves flutter. Water ripples.

narration.say: Predict every pixel, and all those futures blur together.
narration.show: Predict every pixel, and all those futures *blur* together.

narration.say: Most of those details can never be predicted,
narration.show: Most of those details can *never* be predicted,

narration.say: and most of them don't even matter.
narration.show: and most of them don't even *matter*.

narration.say: So don't predict the pixels.
narration.show: So don't predict the *pixels*.

narration.say: Predict the meaning.
narration.show: Predict the *meaning*.

narration.say: Map the world into an abstract space,
narration.show: Map the world into an *abstract space*,

narration.say: and predict it there.
narration.show: and predict it *there*.

narration.say: But there's a catch. If every input lands on the same point,
narration.show: But there's a catch. If every input lands on the *same point*,

narration.say: every prediction is perfect, and the model learns nothing.
narration.show: every prediction is perfect, and the model learns *nothing*.

narration.say: So keep the embeddings spread out, and decorrelated.
narration.show: So keep the embeddings *spread out*, and *decorrelated*.

narration.say: Or let the target encoder slowly follow, as a moving average.
narration.show: Or let the target encoder slowly follow, as a *moving average*.

narration.say: Eye Jeppa shows the model one block of an image,
narration.show: *I-JEPA* shows the model one block of an image,

narration.say: and asks it to predict the features of the missing blocks.
narration.show: and asks it to predict the *features* of the missing blocks.

narration.say: No hand-crafted augmentations. No pixels to rebuild.
narration.show: No hand-crafted augmentations. No pixels to rebuild.

narration.say: Just meaning, predicted from meaning.
narration.show: Just *meaning*, predicted from *meaning*.

narration.say: Then came video. Vee Jeppa masks out space and time,
narration.show: Then came video. *V-JEPA* masks out space and time,

narration.say: and picks up motion, even intuitive physics, just by watching.
narration.show: and picks up motion, even *intuitive physics*, just by watching.

narration.say: Vee Jeppa two became a world model a robot can plan with,
narration.show: *V-JEPA 2* became a *world model* a robot can plan with,

narration.say: imagining the future.
narration.show: imagining the *future*.

narration.say: Not every pixel. Not every detail.
narration.show: Not every pixel. Not every detail.

narration.say: Predict what matters.
narration.show: Predict what *matters*.
